CALLED NRC DUE TO A LEAK OF JL46 PORTION OF THE MOUNTAINWEST PIPELINE SYSTEM IN UTAH. - THE ORIGINAL NOTIFICATION NRC REPORT # 1411463 WAS MADE OUT OF AN ABUNDANCE OF CAUTION IN CASE REPAIR COSTS WERE TO EXCEED THE $145,400 DOLLAR THRESHOLD FOR REPORTING. - OPERATOR WAS ABLE TO CUT OUT AND REPLACE THE AFFECTED SECTION OF PIPE ON 21SEP24 AND LIKELY COSTS HAVE SINCE COME IN BELOW THE THRESHOLD. - THE LEAK WAS DUE TO A PINHOLE UNCOVERED VIA SANDBLASTING AFTER INVESTIGATING ANOMALY FOUND IN AN "ILI" RUN; THE TOTAL GAS RELEASE IS NOT YET CONFIRMED BUT WILL NOT COME CLOSE TO THE (RQ) THRESHOLD DUE TO LEAK SIZE, TIME & PRESSURE. - TOTAL VOLUME WILL BE INCLUDED IN THE 30 DAY INCIDENT REPORT. ORIGINAL NRC REPORT # 1411463 IS AS FOLLOWS: "THE CALLER REPORTED A RELEASE OF AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF NATURAL GAS FROM A TRANSFER PIPELINE THAT WENT INTO THE ATMOSPHERE AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE CAUSE OF THE RELEASE IS DUE TO A CONSTRUCTION VEHICLE ACCIDENTALLY DAMAGING THE LINE." /// THIS IS A 48 HR PHMSA UPDATE ///

properties.title: NRC Report: Benzene near Mont Belvieu, TX
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 889279 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: CONOCOPHILLIPS
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 889279
Incident Time: 2008-11-06 02:58:00
Nearest City: Mont Belvieu, TX
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: BENZENE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: CONOCOPHILLIPS
Skytruth Analysis
GULF COAST FRACTIONATORS AND ITS NEIGHBOURING PLANT ONEOK SHARE THE SAME OCB AT THE ELECTRIC SUB-STATION. WHEN ONEOK WAS PERFORMING REPAIR WORK ON THEIR TRANSFORMER, THE SUDDEN PRESSURE SWITCH VALVE TRIPPED (IT WAS BLOCKED IN AND THUS SHOULD NOT HAVE TRIPPED) AS THE VALVE HAD A LEAK. SICE BOTH THE PLANTS SHARE THE SAME OCB, PROBLEMS WITH ONEOK'S TRANSFORMER TRIPPED BOTH THE OCB AND THE MAIN BREAKERS TO BOTH THE PLANTS THUS CAUSING LOSS OF POWER AT GULF COAST FRACTIONATORS. DURING PLANT STARTUP, PROBLEMS WITH THE INCINERATOR CAUSED IT TO SHUTDOWN AT 20:00 ON NOV 5, 2008. BENZENE VAPORS EMANATING FROM THE GASOLINE TANKS ARE CONTROLLED BY THE INCINERATOR AND SINCE THE INCINERATOR IS CURRENTLY DOWN, THE BENZENE VAPORS ARE UNCONTROLLED. THE INCINERATOR HAS TO BE DOWN FOR 12 HOURS FOR THE BENZENE TO REACH REPORTABLE LEVELS (10 LBS). HOWEVER, DUE TO THE POSSIBILITY THAT BENZENE MIGHT REACH REPORTABLE LEVELS, THIS REPORT IS BEING SUBMITTED.

Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** TWO BOATS DOCKED IN THE WATER AT THE DOGUE CREEK MARINA ON FORT BELVOIR WERE DISCOVERED SUNK TODAY SOMETIME BEFORE NOON 16FEB14. THE IRT (FORT BELVOIR FIRE DEPARTMENT) ACTIVATED THE SPCC PLAN AND RESPONDED. THEY FOUND TWO BOATS SUNK IN THE WATER. VERY LITTLE DIESEL PRODUCT WAS NOTICE. THE IOSC ESTIMATED LESS THAN A QT. OF DIESEL JUST INSIDE THE BOAT FLOATING. THE IRT DEPLOYED ADSORBENT BOOMS TO SURROUND THE BOATS. NO PRODUCTS WAS OBSERVED OUTSIDE THESE BOOMS. MARINA OFFICIALS RESPONDED AND ARE IN PROCESS OF PUMPING OUT THE BOATS TO REFLOAT THEM BOTH. THESE BOATS ARE NOT US GOVERNMENT PROPERTY, BUT BELONG TO INDIVIDUALS UNDER CONTRACT WITH FORT BELVOIR TO DOCK THE CRAFT HERE.

THERE IS CURRENTLY NO VISIBLE SHEEN; POLLUTION IS EXPECTED AS THE VESSEL WAS SEVERELY DAMAGED.

Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS MAKING A REPORT OF INTENTIONAL FUEL DUMPING ACTIVITY FROM A COMMERCIAL AIRCRAFT DUE TO A RADAR FAILURE WHILE IT WAS ORIGINALLY TRAVELING FROM MIAMI, FL TO MADRID. THE AIRCRAFT WAS THEN DIVERTED TO JFK AIRPORT IN NEW YORK. CALLER STATES THE FUEL DUMP TOOK PLACE FOR SAFETY PRECAUTIONS IN ORDER TO AVOID AN OVERRATE LANDING AT JFK AIRPORT. CALLER WAS TOLD IT OCCURRED ABOVE WATERS BETWEEN FLORIDA AND VIRGINIA FOR ABOUT 7 MINUTES. THE COORDINATES THAT WERE GIVEN PLACE THE EXACT LOCATION OFF THE COAST OF SOUTH CAROLINA. THE AIRCRAFT LANDED AT JFK AIRPORT AROUND 2030 EST AFTER PERFORMING THE FUEL DUMP. CALLER ALSO STATES THE FUEL DUMP OCCURRED 33,000 FEET IN THE AIR. CALLER WAS FIRST NOTIFIED OF THIS INCIDENT AT 2112 EST.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1252422 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: JAXON ENERGY
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1252422
Incident Time: 2019-03-22 10:00:00
Nearest City: Jackson, MS
Location: 455 INDUSTRIAL DR
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: JAXON ENERGY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 32.335429, -90.230989 (Approximated from premise)
Reported Spill Volume: 22000 gallon
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTING THAT BETWEEN MAY 25TH AND TODAY COMPANY EMPTIED ACTIVE CATALYST USED TO MAKE RENEWABLE DIESEL FROM REACTOR R21 AND R24 INTO SUPERSACS WHERE THEY CAUGHT FIRE SEVERAL TIMES. EACH TIME THEY CAUGHT FIRE EMPLOYEES WERE DIRECTED TO PUT OUT THE FIRE AND THEN SHOVEL THE CATALYST AROUND AND THEN WASH IT DOWN A STORM DRAIN. CALLER ALSO STATES THAT COMPANY HAS BEEN UNLOADING SLOPS TANKS FILLED WITH DIESEL, SLUDGE AND NAPHTHA INTO AN OIL/WATER SEPARATOR THAT CAN NOT HANDLE THE AMOUNT OF PRODUCT BEING POURED INTO IT AND THE OIL/WATER SEPARATOR IS OVERFLOWING INTO THE CONTAINMENT AREA AND THEN INTO A DITCH AND STORM DRAIN WHERE EMPLOYEES THEN SPAY IT DOWN WITH WATER. EMPLOYEES ARE ALSO SOAKING UP THE MATERIAL USING ABSORBANT PADS AND THEN ARE THROWING THE CONTAMINATED PADS INTO THE TRASH DUMPSTER. CALLER IS ALSO REPORTING THAT HEAT EXCHANGER #4 HAS A CRACK IN IT ALLOWING DIESEL FUEL TO ESCAPE INTO THE COOLING TOWER. THE COOLING TOWER THEN SPRAYS WATER WHICH IS THEN SPREADING THE DIESEL FUEL ONTO THE CONCRETE IN FRONT OF THE COOLING TOWER. EMPLOYEES ARE THEN DIRECTED TO USE POWER WASHERS TO WASH THE DIESEL FUEL INTO A STORM DRAIN.
